items.prompt: After a job finishes and its completion line is emitted, what should the pending queue contain?

options.text: The completed job again with remaining time 0.
options.why: The queue invariant includes unfinished jobs only.

options.text: Exactly the other unfinished job occurrences.
options.why: Completed work is not requeued, so it cannot produce duplicate completion lines.

options.text: Every original job, whether complete or not.
options.why: Retaining completed entries would violate the unfinished-work invariant.

options.text: Only unfinished jobs whose identifiers are unique.
options.why: Equal identifiers remain separate occurrences under the task contract.

items.explanation: Completed work is not requeued, so it cannot produce duplicate completion lines.
